Request for Quotations

 

Purchaser: State Institution “Agriculture Entrepreneurship Development” Project Management Unit  (SI “AED” PMU)

Project: Strengthening Resilience of the Agriculture Sector Project

Grant : IDA-E1450- TJ

 

Name of the Contract: Procurement of furniture for cold storage facilities and canteens for two ALCs in Balkhi District and Khujand City.

Identification number: SRASP-RFQ-GO-2026-03

1. The Republic of Tajikistan has received Grant from the International Development Association for the implementation of the Project "Strengthening Resilience of the Agriculture Sector" and intends to use part of the funds for payments under the contract for the Procurement of furniture for cold storage facilities and canteens for two ALCs in Balkhi District and Khujand City.

2. The State Institution “Agriculture Entrepreneurship Development” Project Management Unit (SI “AED” PMU) hereby invites the eligible bidder to submit their bids for the Procurement of furniture for cold storage facilities and canteens for two ALCs in Balkhi District and Khujand City.

3. Bidding will be conducted through competitive procurement using a Request for Quotation (RFQ) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” July 2016 revised September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”) and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations.

4. All interested eligible bidders may obtain further information from the State Institute “Agriculture Entrepreneurship Development” Project Management Unit (AED PMU) and inspect the bidding document during office hours from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM at E-mail: procurement.srasp@gmail.com as well as at the address given below.

5. All interested Bidders can obtain a copy of the RFQ which contains detailed instructions for preparation of the quotation in Russian by submitting an official letter to the address below or through email. The RFQ can also be obtained from the office of AED PMU located at the address below or through the email procurement.srasp@gmail.com.

7. Bidders shall submit their quotation in hard copy and must deliver to the address below on or before November 04, 15:00. Late offers will be rejected.

The address referred to above is:

For the purpose of receipt and submission of quotations:

To: Satori D.A. – AED PMU Director

Address: I.Somini district, 17 Bokhtar street

Office / Floor: 12nd Floor     

City: Dushanbe

Country: Tajikistan
